name: My Therapy
source:
The protagonist, Hideki Yozo, has just completed art therapy course after a horrible tragedy. Drawing is now his only skill, so he goes to start a new life in art college. But there he's met by perhaps even more broken people than himself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2027550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公阳三秀树在一场可怕的悲剧后刚刚完成艺术治疗课程。现在画画是他唯一的技能，所以他去艺术学院开始了新的生活。但在那里，他遇到的人也许比他自己还要破碎。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2027550/]Steam[/url]]
